scope: Five phone backgrounds and five transparent decorative relic drafts derived from explicitly approved desktops

derivatives.prompt:
Use case: precise-environment-adaptation. Input1 is the explicitly APPROVED CANONICAL Oculum desktop. Derive ONE PORTRAIT PHONE BACKGROUND, 9:16 tall, opaque full environment. Preserve the exact chosen creature identity, anatomy, head/face, material/color palette, clothing, defining details and same environment. Do not redesign it or add organs, limbs, equipment, creature, reward or power. Input2 is only soft matte Rame fatato painting technique; never copy its insects or other scene motifs. Broad soft hand-painted matte tonal masses, gentle atmospheric edges, no plastic shine, 3D rendering, photographic pores or busy new greebles.
Recompose specifically for phone: entire canonical subject or group SMALL along the LOWER edge/side, fully contained including horns, hands, feet, bottles and mantle, with at least8% clear side/bottom margins. Subject height around35–40% of canvas. The TOP two-thirds and central reading column must be DARK, quiet, low contrast environment with very little detail, so real controls and values remain legible. Continue the canonical environment naturally upward, do not merely crop the desktop or stretch the subject. No painted words, symbols, text, UI, cards, frames, borders, watermark, logo. No sun, moon, halo or new celestial sign. No sky/clouds in roofed interiors. This derivative is an UNAPPROVED DRAFT: desktop approval does not approve the derivative.
SPECIFIC CANON: Preserve EXACTLY the chosen olive-gray angular athletic demon with broad swept-back pale blade horns, intelligent wedge face, TWO claw arms/TWO legs, cream knee-wrap trousers, and the VERTICAL large organic toothed mouth from lower neck down upper sternum. Latest explicit user choice is this VERTICAL MOUTH; do not convert it to horizontal. No extra stomach mouth. Keep the same fully roofed mossy gray-green stone hall with arches. Place whole figure low RIGHT with wide margins; giant quiet dark upper hall. Skin is matte organic, not newly armored.
derivatives.visual_inspection: C verticale: pelle oliva, testa e corna a lama, bocca verticale collo/torace, due braccia/due gambe, pantaloni crema; figura intera in basso a destra e grande spazio scuro superiore.

derivatives.prompt:
Use case: decorative-transparent-asset. Input1 is the approved canonical Oculum desktop, used ONLY for thematic materials and specific shapes. Create ONE small isolated DECORATIVE RELIC ORNAMENT for that visual theme on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. This is non-diegetic theme decoration, NOT a newly invented loot item, reward, ability, equipment or power, and NOT a Monster Book portrait or a creature cutout. No whole creature, head, face or eyes. Input2 supplies ONLY soft matte Rame fatato hand-painted brush texture, never copy its insects/motifs. Make a coherent compact diagonal ornamental cluster in the middle, no border/frame or UI.
CRITICAL ALPHA AND MARGINS: all ornament must lie inside central50–55% of canvas with at least22% completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on EVERY side. TRUE alpha-zero background, including entire outer border. No fake checkerboard, no white/black/colored background, no paper, ground, cast shadow, haze or smoke spread into margins, no sparse floating pixels or fragments beyond compact cluster. Soft painted edges but clean isolated silhouette. Matte tactile painting, no gloss/plastic/photoreal/3D/jewel shine. No text/logo/label/runes/sun/moon/halo or new thematic symbol. No weapons unless already a canonical thematic element (none requested here). Unapproved derivative DRAFT.
SPECIFIC ORNAMENT: Use ONLY an abstract arrangement of two swept-back pale BONE blade-like horn motifs from the canonical head, a small curved row of irregular ivory TOOTH motifs and soft muted OLIVE folded organic edging, bound visually by a short faded CREAM cloth knot/fold recalling the canonical trousers. Abstract coherent ornament, no living mouth, jaw/head portrait, torso, eye, blood, severed-body scene, weapon or extra organ. No gold magic spiral.
derivatives.repair_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact TRANSPARENT decorative Oculum ornament. Preserve its design, all motifs, material colors and soft matte hand-painted texture. Change ONLY SIZE and POSITION on canvas: REDUCE the whole ornament to about60% of its CURRENT width/height and CENTER it. It must be visibly SMALL in a much larger empty transparent canvas, with a generous UNIFORM margin of at least25% of total canvas width and height on EVERY side. Do NOT enlarge it to fit the canvas. ALL outer25% on four sides must be empty alpha ZERO, no haze, shadow, smoke, dust, tiny fragments or stray faint pixels. Keep interior holes transparent too. No opaque backdrop or fakecheckerboard; true transparent background. Do not add/remove any ornamental part, head, face, eyes, whole creature, weapons, new symbol, text, UI or frame. No gloss/3D/photo finish; preserve broad matte painted texture. This is an unapproved derivative draft. Keep the same overall canvas aspect and reconstruct transparent empty space around the smaller ornament.
derivatives.repair_reason: Wider transparent padding; original ornament preserved
derivatives.visual_inspection: Ornamento astratto di forme cornee chiare, denti, pieghe oliva e nodo crema; nessun ritratto, occhio o nuovo drop.

Desktop/mobile renderer, interactive readability and online behavior have not been tested by this artwork-only task.
